# Jarvis Metrics and Dashboards

`jarvis-metrics` is a reference workflow for designing Jarvis metrics and dashboards.
It helps choose between existing Geneva/MDM metrics, Kusto-to-Metrics, and Logs-to-Metrics,
then configure dimensions, pre-aggregation, widgets, layers, calculated values, and optional
monitoring.

The guide is intentionally tool-free: it does not bundle Microsoft-internal documentation,
credentials, telemetry libraries, Kusto access, or Jarvis automation.
